blocks.text: Elements ko families mein bhi baanta ja sakta hai. Element family aise elements ka set hai jin ki properties milti-julti hon. Periodic table mein elements ki mashhoor families yeh hain:

items: Alkali metals (Li, Na, K, Rb, Cs, Fr)
Alkaline earth metals (Be, Mg, Ca, Sr, Ba, Ra)
Transition metals (Sc, Ti, V, Cr, Mn, Fe, Co, Ni, Cu, Zn)
Halogens (F, Cl, Br, I, At, Ts)
Noble gases (He, Ne, Ar, Kr, Xe, Rn, Og)
